name: Mirror Lake
description: In the heart of Sindile, within the Mountain Gate temples region, lies the location where the elves first arrived in Tanares. Mirror Lake, blessed by Breith, the Lord of Spring, showcases a stunningly reflective surface that once served as the portal to the elven dying world. It is a sacred place from where elven druids draw water to cleanse the Mother Trees during their purification rituals. Guarded by the heroic nymph Thalia, this lake holds immense sanctity for the Spring Elves and is one of Sindile’s most awe-inspiring locations. The Mirror Lake reflects the expansive gardens, meticulously tended by Thalia, other nymphs, and select archdruids, displaying a vibrant array of enchanted roses of many different colors. Each rose, believed to possess curative properties for various ailments, curses, and penumbral corruption, draws many to the druids for healing. However, Breith stipulates that seekers of the lake’s water or flowers be swiftly aided but then bound by an oath to undertake a task decreed by the god, tailored to the individual’s capabilities, invariably aimed at combating world corruption. The lake’s significance makes it a target for the Cult of Shadow Wing, who seek to corrupt it. Thus, elves, druids, and nymphs remain on high alert, often enlisting adventurers and heroes to thwart the Cult’s schemes. Such tasks may involve venturing beyond the forest to counteract the Cult’s insidious activities in Undertanares or their efforts in the penumbral plane to open a rift in Sindile and unleash an army against the lake. Devotees of Breith and believers in the World Spirits frequent this site, drawn by its unparalleled natural energy. Natural Energy. Within this place, all druid and ranger spells have their duration doubled and gain +2 to their spell DCs and attack rolls, as one can gather much greater natural power here than anywhere else in Tanares. Elves, halflings, and other species inherently tied to nature’s energy who make a long here gain 2 temporary hit points per level, lasting until they rest long. Rose Powers. The roses of Mirror Lake, when distilled into potions, yield powerful remedies. Each potion specifically targets Large beast, unaligned Armor Class 15 (natural) Hit Points 68 (8d10 + 24) Speed 20 ft., fly 60 ft. STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 16 (+3) 15 (+2) 16 (+3) 3 (-4) 8 (-1) 4 (-3) Saving Throws Str +6, Con +6 Skills Athletics +6 Damage Resistances bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks Damage Immunities necrotic, poison Condition Immunities paralyzed, poisoned Senses blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 9 Languages Challenge 5 (1,800 XP) and eradicates afflictions of a certain type, dealing with any of such effects that a wish spell could end. Moreover, consumers gain an advantage on saving throws and resistance to damage related to these afflictions for one week. The following table delineates the ailments each rose color can address: Color Description Purple Curses Red Poisons White Penumbral corruption (also confers advantage against planar effects of the Penumbral Plane) Blue Magical contamination (e.g., exposure to raw magical energies, mana contamination) Grey Necromantic effects Yellow Diseases (including magical Orange Mind effects and mental manipulation Swarm of Wasps. The wasp queen is accompanied by swarms of insects (wasps), which use the creature’s abdomen as their home. The wasp queen has 2 (1d4) swarms inside it, releasing them, in an adjacent free space, as soon as it engages in combat. Paralyzing Poison. The wasps that inhabit the interior of the wasp queen acquire a paralyzing poison. A creature that suffers a successful attack from a swarm of the wasp queen’s wasps must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned for one minute. A creature poisoned in this way is also paralyzed. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending both effects on itself on a success. Actions Sting. Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit:9 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned target is paralyzed, and it can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.
